question.problem: Change the order of integration in the double integral ${\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{2y+1}^{3}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y.$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14154008/assets/03a006f46e78ec893c21d2a871c54eeccbdb0d74b19385a6a569f787ee1bdd2d.png)

The diagram above shows the region of integration. It is a type II region, and its type II representation is

$$
D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le y\le 1,\,2y+1\le x\le 3\}.
$$

Notice that the top boundary of the region, written in the form $x=x(y),$ is

$$
x=2y+1\,⟹\,y=\frac{x-1}{2},
$$

and the bottom boundary of the region is

$$
y=0.
$$

To change the order of integration, we write $D$ as a type I region. The type I representation of the region is

$$
D=\{(x,y)\,:\,1\le x\le 3,\,0\le y\le \frac{x-1}{2}\},
$$

as shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14154008/assets/d27e38c7c3de8dda353151cd0347d6bead91cb19d2eb90d08dd485d77899bc27.png)

Therefore, swapping the order of integration, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{2y+1}^{3}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y & ={\int }_{1}^{3}{\int }_{0}^{(x-1)/2}f(x,y)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$
